title: Inference cost and price–performance
scope: Separate source review, integrated as documentation and original factual research metadata. No source corpus or source-response receipts are included.
third_party_rights: Original factual metadata does not relicense linked source artifacts; collection-level and artifact-specific holds remain in force.
verdict: Keep the four collections. MLPerf is the best bounded measurement pilot; ML.ENERGY is the new family with the largest energy-data value but unresolved public-summary rights and quality; Epoch contributes original token-use aggregates and mixed-provenance historical prices; DeepSeek supplies factual tariff events. No inspected source links immutable identity, achieved quality, measured energy and net charges into one complete series.

priority_ranking.reason: Direct GPU-energy and serving-configuration measurements; rights and quality holds prevent general admission.
Original token-use aggregates and historical tariff observations, with mixed-provenance holds.
First-party tariff complement; no measured service cost.

interpretation_guards: Advertised tariff, tariff-derived estimated expenditure, invoice charge and provider economic cost are distinct quantities. None establishes subsidy.
GPU energy, whole-system AC power and datacenter energy have different boundaries; joules and watts are not interchangeable.
Compare only within compatible benchmark/task/scenario/quality/measurement regimes. Retain hardware count, precision, serving settings, context/output distributions, date type and revision.
Model display names, API aliases and immutable checkpoint identities are separate. Missing identities or per-request denominators remain missing.
Represent reused runs, copied artifacts and restated provider events once with lineage. No universal efficiency curve or conversion to risk probability.

limitations: Summary sample-pool count is not requests completed during a power interval. Configured TTFT/TPOT are not measured latency. Offline log latency is not online API latency.
Log mode PerformanceOnly does not mean the submission lacks power evidence: spl.txt is present. Actual energy interval and denominator were not reconstructed.
Source says Original Huggingface model weights without revision. CUDA 12.8 and 12.9 coexist in different system fields and must remain conflicting.
Quality-tier suffixes are benchmark-relative targets, not generic accuracy percentages. Log VALID is not a permanent publication-status assertion.
Whole-system AC at-wall boundary is documented. Vendor selection and sparse power submissions limit coverage; v5.1 announcement names only Lenovo and GATEOverflow.

duplicate_evidence.treatment: Two quality-tier assertions linked to one shared performance/power artifact group. Power blob body not downloaded.

collections.next_action: Use a small manifest-based mapping of already acquired files; confirm full result identifier and current publication/correction status before outward result publication. Do not reconstruct power totals without a complete matched interval.
collections.sample_interpretation: Historical pinned artifact example. Log VALID is retained as a source field, not a claim of current official publication approval; current correction/invalidation status is an open follow-up.

Immutable weights, exact input/context distributions, full serving revision and run date are unresolved.
January 2026 throughput change is a correction, not progress. last_updated is compilation time, not experiment time.
Current toolkit has stability filtering; do not assume current filtering exactly reconstructs the pinned public export without a matched build definition.

collections.historical_coverage: Two price tables span 2021-11-20 through 2025-02-05. Token aggregate includes later model identifiers, including gpt-4.5-preview-2025-02-27; these are model labels, not verified run timestamps. Webpage publication March 12, 2025 and download refresh November 20, 2025 do not extend pinned price coverage.
collections.update_frequency: Research snapshot with later website refresh; no documented live price feed.
collections.access: Public small CSVs and a 437,684-byte notebook read statically; raw evaluation-log reconstruction not established.
collections.rights: Epoch page grants Creative Commons Attribution reuse for Epoch's work. Repository root has no LICENSE. Mixed AA-derived fields need upstream rights/provenance checks; current GL036 restrictions do not by themselves prove the precise legal status of this 2025 research release. Hold mixed redistribution until scoped.
limitations: total_samples includes repeated evaluations; preserve epochs. Aggregates do not pair each answer's correctness with billed charge.
Price uses 3:1 input/output weighting, first-party API where available or provider median, and shortest-context price when prices differ by allowed context.
Release Date can be a repricing event. Repricing is not model birth or an evaluation timestamp.
Notebook estimates USD/question = total_tokens / total_samples × blended USD/million / 1e6; it does not use actual input/output mixture or invoice/cache/credit accounting.
Static mapping gpt-4-0613→GPT-4-0314 and collapsed reasoning-effort labels are analytical substitutions, not checkpoint equivalence.

Scores combine AA, original Epoch evaluations, developer reports and Papers with Code. Reasoning models were excluded from published per-token-price trend analysis; do not generalize that trend to all rows.

duplicate_evidence.treatment: Link AA-sourced prices/scores to GL036 at field/observation level. Epoch original evaluation runs are distinct measurements; same model/benchmark alone is not duplication. Prior AE003/TD005 are producer overlap only. Original model-token rows cannot all be treated as independent task questions.

collections.next_action: Separate original Epoch token-use rows from mixed prices/scores, record each model mapping and repricing event, and resolve attribution/third-party rights before bundling raw tables.

acceptance_criteria: Accept only allowlisted pinned artifacts and preserve units/numeric source strings.
Recover 376.512 samples/s, 102909 tokens/s and achieved ROUGE without treating 24,576 as timed request count.
Preserve both tiers while deduplicating identical summary/power blobs.

Checkpoint unresolved and both CUDA strings retained; missing energy/cost remain null.
Preserve source date/revision/status and scoped rights; later invalidation/correction is a revision, not another independent experiment.

follow_up_prompts.title: Confirm MLPerf publication status
follow_up_prompts.prompt: Review only MLPerf Inference v5.1 Lenovo result 5.1-0061, SR680a_V3_B200SXMx8_TRT, Llama2-70B Offline 99/99.9, pinned at 5ea4f62ef62536e6bf4d78a9b440fb9035ddfb4a. Existing summary/accuracy/configuration artifacts are already checked. Return any correction/invalidation and its date, or explicitly say none found in inspected material.
